# telnyx_10dlc_phone_number_campaigns (Data Source)

Lists 10dlc phone number campaigns, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_10dlc_phone_number_campaign`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_tcr_brand_id` (String) Filter results by the TCR Brand id
- `filter_tcr_campaign_id` (String) Filter results by the TCR Campaign id
- `filter_telnyx_brand_id` (String) Filter results by the Telnyx Brand id
- `filter_telnyx_campaign_id` (String) Filter results by the Telnyx Campaign id
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) Specifies the sort order for results. If not given, results are sorted by created_at in descending order. One of `-assignmentStatus`, `-createdAt`, `-phoneNumber`, `assignmentStatus`, `createdAt`, `phoneNumber`.

### Read-Only

- `phone_number_campaigns` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_campaigns))

<a id="nestedatt--phone_number_campaigns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_number_campaigns`

Read-Only:

- `assignment_status` (String) The assignment status of the number.
- `brand_id` (String) Brand ID. Empty if the number is associated to a shared campaign.
- `campaign_id` (String) For shared campaigns, this is the TCR campaign ID, otherwise it is the campaign ID
- `created_at` (String)
- `failure_reasons` (String) Extra info about a failure to assign/unassign a number. Relevant only if the assignmentStatus is either FAILED_ASSIGNMENT or FAILED_UNASSIGNMENT
- `non_tmobile_number_mapping_status` (String) The assignment status of the number towards other carriers.
- `phone_number` (String)
- `tcr_brand_id` (String) TCR's alphanumeric ID for the brand.
- `tcr_campaign_id` (String) TCR's alphanumeric ID for the campaign.
- `telnyx_campaign_id` (String) Campaign ID. Empty if the number is associated to a shared campaign.
- `tmobile_number_mapping_status` (String) The T-Mobile assignment status of the number.
- `updated_at` (String)
